name: set_ic_pins
summary: Set an IC Housing's pins d0 to d5 as a screwdriver does: a device id per pin, null to clear. Every pin is checked before any is written.

help.text: Pins left out keep their device. A running chip uses the new devices from its next instruction; nothing recompiles or resets, and a multiplayer host sends the pins to clients. Returns what it altered and all six pins as get_ic_status lists them. Rocket IC Housings work too; suits and other worn holders are not_ic_housing.

network.summary: Devices off the housing's data network.
network.text: On a data network, the chip reaches a pin's device only on that network, so a device off it is refused (not_on_data_network) unless allow_off_network is true; then reachable is false and the pin reads as unset until the device is cabled in. A housing with no data network reaches pinned devices anywhere.

refusals.text: device_not_found: the housing or a pin's device is outside the scope. thing_not_found: nothing has a pin's id. not_logic_device: the id is not a device (a frame, a pipe). logic_not_readable: a device with no readable logic. not_on_data_network: see network. invalid_argument: a bad pins object, pin name or id, a pin listed twice, or the housing itself. A refused call writes no pin.

allow_off_network.description: Store a device not on the housing's data network (about to be cabled in). Default false.
